name: Exp_LeManSignal
summary: This EA uses the custom LeManSignal indicator to generate buy and sell signals based on momentum direction. It opens and closes positions on new bar events, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The EA includes mutual signal cancellation logic and a historical bar scan for determining close signals when both open and close permissions are enabled.
summary_zh: 该EA使用自定义LeManSignal指标根据动量方向产生买入和卖出信号。它在新K线事件上开仓和平仓，具有可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈。EA包含互斥信号消除逻辑，并在同时允许开仓和平仓时扫描历史K线以确定平仓信号。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于LeManSignal自定义指标的动量信号，该指标通过可调节的周期参数(LPeriod=12)计算多空方向。入场条件为：当指标上轨(UpValue)在指定信号K线上产生非空值时做多，当指标下轨(DnValue)产生非空值时做空。出场条件有两种方式：一是反向信号触发平仓（如持仓多单时出现下轨信号），二是在同时允许开仓和平仓的情况下，通过扫描历史K线寻找最早的反向信号作为平仓依据。仓位管理采用MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示基于资金的百分比计算手数。资金管理通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数实现，配合止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)参数进行风险控制。EA还实现了多空信号同时出现时的互相取消机制，避免在矛盾信号下开仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum signals from the custom LeManSignal indicator, which calculates bullish/bearish direction through an adjustable period parameter (LPeriod=12). Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the indicator's upper buffer (UpValue) produces a non-empty, non-zero value on the specified signal bar, and a short position is opened when the lower buffer (DnValue) produces a valid signal. Exit conditions work in two ways: first, a reverse signal triggers position closure (e.g., a down signal closes a long), and second, when both open and close permissions are enabled, the EA scans historical bars backward to find the earliest opposing signal as the close trigger. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent percentage-based lot calculation relative to account equity. Money management is implemented through the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen), combined with stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) parameters for risk control. The EA also implements a mutual cancellation mechanism when both buy and sell signals appear simultaneously, preventing position opening under contradictory signals.

parameters.description_en: Allow closing buy positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing sell positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于检测信号的K线编号

pros: 具有完整的买卖开仓和平仓独立控制开关，灵活性高
实现了多空信号互斥取消机制，避免矛盾信号同时开仓
使用IsNewBar进行信号检测，避免同一根K线内重复交易
止损止盈参数齐全，基本风险控制到位
历史K线扫描逻辑为平仓提供了更细致的判断依据
pros_en: Complete independent toggle switches for buy/sell open and close operations, offering high flexibility
Implements mutual cancellation logic when conflicting buy and sell signals appear simultaneously
Uses IsNewBar for signal detection, preventing duplicate trades within the same bar
Stop loss and take profit parameters are properly configured with basic risk control in place
Historical bar scanning logic provides a more refined basis for close decisions
cons: LeManSignal指标为自定义黑盒指标，核心逻辑不透明，难以验证信号有效性
历史K线扫描平仓逻辑可能遍历大量K线，存在性能风险且缺乏遍历上限保护
缺乏点差过滤，在波动市场可能因高滑点造成不利成交
MM参数为负值表示固定手数的设计不够直观，容易误操作
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
cons_en: LeManSignal is a custom black-box indicator with opaque core logic, making signal validity hard to verify
The historical bar scanning close logic may iterate through many bars without an upper loop limit, posing performance risks
No spread filter is implemented, which could lead to unfavorable fills in volatile markets with high slippage
The MM parameter's negative-value-for-fixed-lot design is unintuitive and prone to misconfiguration
No existing position check before opening new trades, potentially causing duplicate positions in the same direction
improvements: 添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
为历史K线扫描添加最大遍历K线数限制，防止无限循环
improvements_en: Add position existence check before opening new trades to prevent duplicate same-direction positions
Add a maximum bar iteration limit to the historical scanning loop to prevent potential infinite iteration

risk_points: 缺乏持仓检查可能导致同方向重复开仓，增加风险敞口
历史K线遍历无上限保护，在数据量大的情况下可能导致EA卡顿
risk_points_en: Lack of position check may lead to duplicate same-direction positions, increasing risk exposure
Historical bar iteration has no upper bound protection, potentially causing EA lag with large data volumes
